name: whiskful-ai-evals
description: Phase 0 provider evaluation harness for Whiskful's AI services (promptfoo). Measures Gemini vs OpenAI vs Claude per service before any gateway refactor.

scripts.all: npm run tips && npm run recipe-gen && npm run import && npm run nutrition && npm run meal
scripts.validate: promptfoo validate config -c configs/cooking-tips.yaml && promptfoo validate config -c configs/meal-suggestions.yaml && promptfoo validate config -c configs/recipe-generation.yaml && promptfoo validate config -c configs/recipe-import.yaml && promptfoo validate config -c configs/nutrition-estimation.yaml
scripts.scorecard: node scorecard/generate.mjs output && echo Wrote scorecard/scorecard.md
